# E0704: edit that doesn't parse as its part

A body's new text is a block, and a declaration's is one declaration of the same kind. Nothing was written.

- Rule: [`edits.refusals`](../../reference/19-tools.md#edits.refusals)
- Reported at: the first syntax error of the new text, in the edit's text; the start of the text when it parses but is not the part.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `refusal` phase

## What the compiler prints

The program [`E0704_other_kind_of_declaration.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0704_other_kind_of_declaration.lt):

`E0704_other_kind_of_declaration.lt`:

```stilt fragment
/// Totals what the orders sold.
fn totals(orders: List<i64>) -> i64 {
  var sum = 0
  for qty in orders {
    sum += qty
  }
  sum
}
```

`E0704_other_kind_of_declaration.edits`, beside it:

```text

type Totals = { sum: i64 }
```
